findings.reason: as written a public, empty or partial package lands with the section, which would make section 1's promise that ICP-derived content "is covered by the facility-scoped protected backup" false while the gate log reads green.
findings.text: the added clause "a facility-scoped private archive holding the imported nodes and links is taken before the section lands, with its package name, visibility and digest in the landing record" has no failing condition: it requires visibility to be *recorded*, never to be private; it requires the package to hold the imported nodes and links without counting the imported nodes the package was found to contain; and it states no quiescence precondition, while section 9 — which waits on section 4 — is the only place that says "No graph writer is running when the archive is taken", so the day-one protection copy is taken under no stated consistency rule. The section's declared negative control still tests only link assignment, so nothing in section 4 can show the second copy exists, is private, or is complete

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — the plan hrefs icp-api-access and codac-uda-signals resolve to docs/plans/<name>.html, the figure docs/figures/iter-signal-context-and-enrichment/pipeline.svg exists, and each section anchor cited in the declarations is present in the snapshot.
rubric_items.done_when: a finding — the archive clause newly added to section 4's done-when (plan.html:60) states no condition that can fail, so a public or incomplete package still satisfies it.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — every done-when in the changed units rests on a landing record, the plan's durable evidence surface, which sections 2, 3 and 5 already write under docs/evidence/fragments/iter-signal-context-and-enrichment/; no node-local or scratch path is named.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the version-29 edits are prose in a decision and a done-when; neither changed unit introduces a plan label, stage name, ticket number or version tag into a name or comment.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — the decision's context now reports section 3's stored figures as they stand (local 0 of 20 responses parsed unrepaired and 130 of 200 delivered; paid 20 of 20 and 200 of 200 for USD 0.95), and the rationale records both the build-after-refinement branch and the return-to-lead branch, so neither the stated cause nor the endpoint outruns the evidence.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — section 4 still delivers one thing, the pilot system's imported context and its links; the archive is a protection condition on that content rather than a second deliverable, and no node was split by the version-29 edit.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — every declared depends-on target resolves (icp-api-access#s3, icp-api-access#s4 and codac-uda-signals#s12 all exist and carry an unstruck declaration), section 10 is now a dependency of section 9's link set, and section 4's read path is delivered by the ICP plan's sections 2 to 4.
